claim_ledger.claim: Story Mode contains a Prologue and five numbered chapters.
The observed campaign order is Prologue, then Chapters 1–5 in the named order recorded in the research handoff.
The Prologue route observed in the reviewed walkthroughs moves from orderly encounters to the power/gate state and then to the station wagon.
Chapter 1 progression observed in the reviewed walkthroughs moves through Rabbit in Red and red/noise tracking toward the mechanic.
Chapter 2 observed progression includes mask acquisition, named-target progression, the Judith Myers tombstone sequence, and a return toward the car.
Chapter 3 observed progression enters the Myers House flashback before later neighborhood objectives.
Chapter 4 observed progression is anchored by the Wallace House event chain, including Bob/Lynda states, the Sheet state, and the later Laurie chase.
Chapter 5 observed progression changes from police pressure/search to an escape or ending-route commitment state; the exact reliable route order remains unresolved here.
Optional challenges and collectibles are replay content tied to the six playable chapters.

Current community reports describe possible save/reset, challenge/log registration, relock/loop, and Chapter 4 AI/timing problems in Early Access; these reports are not confirmed as universal reproduction and do not establish a guaranteed workaround.
